A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have computed the impact factor at NLO accuracy for the scattering of a quark-antiquark pair in the color-octet state, which is the leading contribution to the gluon-induced production of a pair of heavy-quark mesons.
we have computed the NLO corrections to a process which is not only of interest for the LHC, but also for the RHIC and the future EIC.
we have computed the NLO impact factor for the Mueller-Tang jet production at the LHC, and we have found a significant suppression of the cross-section with respect to the LO result.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the jet production cross section in proton-nucleus collisions at next-to-leading order (NLO) can be computed with a factorization formula that includes the nuclear modification of the parton densities in the nucleus.
the jet impact factor is finite and calculable in QCD, and that it is not plagued by the infrared divergences that have been a source of concern in the past.
